title: Her Domain
subtitle: The earth is her only realm
text: The Pale Lady's domain is the Earth itself. She has no separate dimension, no underworld, no realm beyond. She is associated with still and cold water, with winter, with forgetting — her connection to the mythological River Lethe, the waters of forgetfulness. The moon is believed to be an expression of her watchful presence, a guardian eye. This is partly why she is outmatched by a being that exists partly outside the world. She is bound to it in a way the Entity is not. She knows this. She does not aspire to destroy the Entity. Her duty is to protect the world — not to pursue the source.
